ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a Bode magnitude plot with magnitude in dB on the vertical axis and angular frequency omega in rad/s on the horizontal axis. The marked break frequencies are 2, 4, 8, 24, and 36 rad/s. The plotted slopes are -6 dB/octave from 0.01 to 2, 0 dB/octave from 2 to 4, +6 dB/octave from 4 to 8, 0 dB/octave from 8 to 24, -6 dB/octave from 24 to 36, and -12 dB/octave after 36. The low-frequency ordinate at omega = 0.01 is taken as 76 dB. Inference: The transfer function has an integrator, giving the initial -20 dB/decade slope. The known zero 1 + 0.5s has corner frequency 1/0.5 = 2 rad/s, matching the upward slope change at 2 rad/s. The known pole 1 + s/8 has corner frequency 8 rad/s, matching the downward slope change at 8 rad/s. The known pole 1 + s/36 has corner frequency 36 rad/s, matching the downward slope change at 36 rad/s. Therefore the remaining upward slope change at 4 rad/s must come from the zero 1 + as, so 1/a = 4 and a = 1/4. The remaining downward slope change at 24 rad/s must come from the pole 1 + 8bs, so 1/(8b) = 24, hence b = 1/192. In the low-frequency region, all first-order factors are approximately 1, so |G(j omega)| approximately equals K/omega. At omega = 0.01, 76 = 20 log10(K/0.01), so K = 0.01 * 10^(76/20) approximately 63.1. Thus a/(bK) = (1/4)/((1/192)K) = 48/K = 48/63.1 approximately 0.76.

图像描述：图中是幅频 Bode 渐近线图，横轴为 omega(rad/s)，纵轴为 dB。可见竖向虚线标出了 2、4、8、24、36 rad/s 等转折频率。曲线斜率依次为：0.01 到 2 rad/s 为 -6 dB/octave，2 到 4 rad/s 为 0 dB/octave，4 到 8 rad/s 为 +6 dB/octave，8 到 24 rad/s 为 0 dB/octave，24 到 36 rad/s 为 -6 dB/octave，36 rad/s 之后为 -12 dB/octave。

推理：已知因子 1+0.5s 的零点转折频率为 1/0.5 = 2 rad/s，对应图中 2 rad/s 处斜率增加 +6 dB/octave。图中 4 rad/s 处又有一个 +6 dB/octave 的斜率变化，因此它来自未知零点 1+as，所以 1/a = 4，得 a = 1/4。

未知极点因子为 1+8bs，其转折频率为 1/(8b)。图中 24 rad/s 处斜率减少 -6 dB/octave，因此 1/(8b) = 24，得 b = 1/192。

按给定方法，用图中 omega = 0.01 rad/s 处的 76 dB 幅值确定 8 到 24 rad/s 的平台值。从 0.01 到 2 rad/s 斜率为 -20 dB/decade，下降量为 20log10(2/0.01) = 20log10(200) ≈ 46 dB，所以 2 rad/s 处约为 76 - 46 = 30 dB。2 到 4 rad/s 为平坦段，仍约 30 dB。4 到 8 rad/s 斜率为 +20 dB/decade，上升量为 20log10(8/4) = 20log10(2) ≈ 6 dB，因此 8 到 24 rad/s 平台约为 36 dB。

36 dB 转为线性增益为 10^(36/20) ≈ 63.1。对 8 < omega < 24 的中频段，近似幅值为 K(0.5omega)(aomega) / [omega(omega/8)] = 4aK。由于 a = 1/4，所以 4aK = K ≈ 63.1。

因此 a/(bK) = (1/4)/[(1/192)K] = 48/K ≈ 48/63.1 ≈ 0.76。

推理：已知零点因子 \(1+0.5s\) 的转折频率为 \(1/0.5=2\) rad/s，它使斜率增加 \(+6\) dB/octave，正对应图中 \(2\) rad/s 处由 \(-6\) 变为 \(0\) 的变化。图中 \(4\) rad/s 处又有一次 \(+6\) dB/octave 的斜率增加，因此对应未知零点 \(1+as\)，故
\[
\frac{1}{a}=4 \quad\Rightarrow\quad a=\frac14.
\]
未知极点因子为 \(1+8bs\)，其转折频率为 \(1/(8b)\)。图中 \(24\) rad/s 处斜率减少 \(-6\) dB/octave，因此
\[
\frac{1}{8b}=24 \quad\Rightarrow\quad b=\frac{1}{192}.
\]
为求 \(K\)，按题目原图/给定幅值读数取 \(\omega=0.01\) rad/s 处幅值为 76 dB。从 \(0.01\) 到 \(2\) rad/s，斜率为 \(-20\) dB/decade，下降量为
\[
20\log_{10}\frac{2}{0.01}=20\log_{10}(200)\approx 46\text{ dB},
\]
所以 \(2\) rad/s 处幅值约为 \(76-46=30\) dB。\(2\) 到 \(4\) rad/s 为平坦段，仍约为 30 dB。\(4\) 到 \(8\) rad/s 斜率为 \(+20\) dB/decade，上升量为
\[
20\log_{10}\frac{8}{4}=20\log_{10}2\approx 6\text{ dB},
\]
因此 \(8\) 到 \(24\) rad/s 的平台幅值约为 \(36\) dB。换算为线性增益：
\[
10^{36/20}\approx 63.1.
\]
在 \(8<\omega<24\) 的平台频段，\(1+0.5s\approx 0.5s\)，\(1+as\approx as\)，\(1+s/8\approx s/8\)，而 \(1+8bs\) 与 \(1+s/36\) 尚近似为 1，因此渐近幅值为
\[
\left|G(j\omega)\right|\approx \frac{K(0.5\omega)(a\omega)}{\omega(\omega/8)}=4aK.
\]
代入 \(a=1/4\)，得 \(4aK=K\approx 63.1\)。于是
\[
\frac{a}{bK}=\frac{1/4}{(1/192)K}=\frac{48}{K}\approx \frac{48}{63.1}\approx 0.76.
\]
所以 \(\frac{a}{bK}\approx 0.76\)。

solver_metadata.cot_raw:
图像描述：图中是幅频 Bode 渐近线图，横轴为 omega(rad/s)，纵轴为 dB。可见竖向虚线标出了 2、4、8、24、36 rad/s 等转折频率。曲线斜率依次为：0.01 到 2 rad/s 为 -6 dB/octave，2 到 4 rad/s 为 0 dB/octave，4 到 8 rad/s 为 +6 dB/octave，8 到 24 rad/s 为 0 dB/octave，24 到 36 rad/s 为 -6 dB/octave，36 rad/s 之后为 -12 dB/octave。

推理：已知因子 1+0.5s 的零点转折频率为 1/0.5 = 2 rad/s，对应图中 2 rad/s 处斜率增加 +6 dB/octave。图中 4 rad/s 处又有一个 +6 dB/octave 的斜率变化，因此它来自未知零点 1+as，所以 1/a = 4，得 a = 1/4。

未知极点因子为 1+8bs，其转折频率为 1/(8b)。图中 24 rad/s 处斜率减少 -6 dB/octave，因此 1/(8b) = 24，得 b = 1/192。

按给定方法，用图中 omega = 0.01 rad/s 处的 76 dB 幅值确定 8 到 24 rad/s 的平台值。从 0.01 到 2 rad/s 斜率为 -20 dB/decade，下降量为 20log10(2/0.01) = 20log10(200) ≈ 46 dB，所以 2 rad/s 处约为 76 - 46 = 30 dB。2 到 4 rad/s 为平坦段，仍约 30 dB。4 到 8 rad/s 斜率为 +20 dB/decade，上升量为 20log10(8/4) = 20log10(2) ≈ 6 dB，因此 8 到 24 rad/s 平台约为 36 dB。

36 dB 转为线性增益为 10^(36/20) ≈ 63.1。对 8 < omega < 24 的中频段，近似幅值为 K(0.5omega)(aomega) / [omega(omega/8)] = 4aK。由于 a = 1/4，所以 4aK = K ≈ 63.1。

因此 a/(bK) = (1/4)/[(1/192)K] = 48/K ≈ 48/63.1 ≈ 0.76。

raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The figure is a Bode magnitude plot with magnitude in dB on the vertical axis and angular frequency omega in rad/s on the horizontal axis. The marked break frequencies are 2, 4, 8, 24, and 36 rad/s. The plotted slopes are -6 dB/octave from 0.01 to 2, 0 dB/octave from 2 to 4, +6 dB/octave from 4 to 8, 0 dB/octave from 8 to 24, -6 dB/octave from 24 to 36, and -12 dB/octave after 36. The low-frequency ordinate at omega = 0.01 is taken as 76 dB.
Inference: The transfer function has an integrator, giving the initial -20 dB/decade slope. The known zero 1 + 0.5s has corner frequency 1/0.5 = 2 rad/s, matching the upward slope change at 2 rad/s. The known pole 1 + s/8 has corner frequency 8 rad/s, matching the downward slope change at 8 rad/s. The known pole 1 + s/36 has corner frequency 36 rad/s, matching the downward slope change at 36 rad/s. Therefore the remaining upward slope change at 4 rad/s must come from the zero 1 + as, so 1/a = 4 and a = 1/4. The remaining downward slope change at 24 rad/s must come from the pole 1 + 8bs, so 1/(8b) = 24, hence b = 1/192. In the low-frequency region, all first-order factors are approximately 1, so |G(j omega)| approximately equals K/omega. At omega = 0.01, 76 = 20 log10(K/0.01), so K = 0.01 * 10^(76/20) approximately 63.1. Thus a/(bK) = (1/4)/((1/192)K) = 48/K = 48/63.1 approximately 0.76.
